description: The Graphenintegrations-Plattform (GIP.at) is Austria's official intermodal transport reference system, maintained by the Österreichisches Institut für Verkehrsdateninfrastruktur (ÖVDAT) for the federal states, ASFINAG, ÖBB Infrastruktur and ITS Vienna Region. Contents: the open data export holds a routing export in IDF format; the GIP Network base graph with sections, nodes, links, usage strips (lanes and paths by mode) and turn relations; reference objects on the base graph such as bridges and tunnels (layer Brunnel), reference points, cycle routes and geographic names; lookup tables; and local data such as the Vorarlberg cycle network. Coverage: the whole of Austria, all modes on public roads and paths (car, bicycle, pedestrian). Format and access: GeoPackage and text (IDF) files downloaded as ZIP archives from open.gip.gv.at (the base network archive is about 4 GB), with an export specification and the GIP data capture standard as PDF; the export is refreshed every two months (version GIP 2026/04, catalogue entry modified 8 July 2026). Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the export format changed in December 2025, so older tools reading the previous format need updating; attributes vary by the data owner that captured each area. Simulation uses: a routable national road, cycle and footpath network for network flow and accessibility models, traffic assignment and hazard exposure of links, bridges and tunnels. Related records: the Austrian Federal Railways open data (data-austria-oebb-open-data) covers the rail side.
